text:
ellie: quick sync idea 
Run a short PLG launch pilot next week: coordinated social launch posts + gated 20-credit webinar + a 3-prompt "starter kit". track benchmarks (engagement, rsvp->first-gen) and compare to last month's onboarding baseline.
theo: nice. what's the primary KPI?
ellie: primary = 7-day activation (first 3 generations). secondary = webinar attend rate and shareable social CTR. target lift 7-11% activation vs baseline.
cale: how do we route inbound leads who RSVP but are sales-ready? want to auto-tag and send to SDR queue.
ellie: route: rsvp -> qualification form (one q: org size) -> if org size >50 or checkbox = enterprise interest, tag "sales:hot" and create lead in HubSpot. otherwise keep in PLG nurture.
maru: segment = new signups 0-30 days + zero usage. exclude paid trials. cale can you build that query and export?
ops-bot: reminder: workflow "grant_credits_v3" requires approval step by @maru before granting.
theo: social plan: 3 posts (product tease, webinar CTA, primer w/ prompt examples). we'll add UTM seeds: ?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=sparkbench_apr. add route=starterkit for banner links.
ellie: also publish a short benchmark narrative blog post with a small graph comparing avg-first-run token counts from baseline to pilot. that'll help sales copy. theo pls draft.
cale: I'll set up AB test for banner copy (long explainer vs short CTA). control split = 75/25 holdback:exposed to keep power for other launches.
maru: QA checklist: segment export, HubSpot mapping for "sales:hot", RSVP page with hidden route param, prompt-kit asset hosted, credit workflow approval, analytics dashboard (rsvp->attend->first-gen).
ellie: assign: cale = segment + hubspot mapping + export; theo = social + blog draft + RSVP page; maru = credit approval + analytics dashboard; i'll own prompt pack + cadence + final copy.
ops-bot: calendar event created: "Sparkbench: Starter Kit Webinar + Social Launch" Thu Apr 25 11:00.
theo: for CTA copy options: long = "Join a quick webinar + get 20 starter credits and 3 prompts to kickstart models"; short = "Get 20 credits + 3 prompts  30m webinar". prefer testing both.
maru: about credits: attendance-only grant, T+0.5 day nudge if they haven't used credits. ops-bot will enforce approval flow.
cale: shared drive folder: https://drive.redwood.example/sparkbench with RSVP page mock and draft CTAs. check perms.
ellie: also want a small influencer outreach list: 5 micro-influencers who write about dev tools. we'll offer early access + co-authored microcase. theo pls compile.
theo: will do. syncing tues 10am to confirm go/no-go. quick question: do we keep email copy identical to banner?
ellie: yes keep email identical; only banner AB differs.
maru: building dashboard now, will add alert if attend rate < 25% of RSVPs.
ellie: great. thanks team :sparkles:
